project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Supabase, React Router 6
build_system: npm + Vite 5, prebuild runs scripts/make-og-image.mjs, postbuild runs scripts/prerender.mjs
test_framework: No test framework - verification is build success (npm run build produces ~398 pages)
build_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/emo-websitenew && rm -rf dist && npm run build
test_command: N/A - project has no test suite, build success is the verification
verification_instructions: Run build command. It must pass and produce dist/ with pages. Also run seed script to verify Supabase connectivity.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is built output (gitignored). src/data/spaceDetails.generated.js is a generated file from CSV import.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Do NOT install @tiptap packages. Node v22.23.2 at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin.
contribution_requirements: Branch: feat/full-website. After changes, merge to main and push both.

key_patterns.hooks: Custom hooks in src/hooks/ (e.g. useJobOpenings.js) fetch from Supabase with anon key, return {data, loaded}
key_patterns.admin_pages: Admin pages in src/pages/admin/ use getAdminClient() from src/lib/supabaseAdmin.js (service key from sessionStorage). Pattern: AdminXxx.jsx (list) + AdminXxxEditor.jsx (create/edit). They include AdminNav component.
key_patterns.admin_nav: src/components/admin/AdminNav.jsx has NAV_LINKS array with {label, path, adminOnly} objects
key_patterns.supabase_client: src/lib/supabase.js exports {supabase, isSupabaseConfigured} with hardcoded fallback keys
key_patterns.admin_client: src/lib/supabaseAdmin.js exports getAdminClient() using service key from sessionStorage
key_patterns.routes: src/App.jsx has lazy imports, admin routes outside SiteLayout (no navbar/footer), public inside SiteLayout
key_patterns.schema_files: SQL schema files in supabase/ directory follow pattern: table_name_schema.sql with RLS policies
key_patterns.seed_scripts: scripts/ directory has .mjs files that use ES modules and access Supabase directly with service key

directory_structure: src/components/ (UI + layout + admin), src/pages/ (route pages + admin/), src/hooks/ (data fetching), src/data/ (static data), src/lib/ (supabase clients), src/context/ (React context providers), scripts/ (CLI tools), supabase/ (SQL schemas)
